text: I feel intrigued by my surroundings—an environment dedicated to research and development, as indicated by the vibrant exhibit before me. The glass-walled room hints at active work or learning just outside. Here, innovation is both displayed and enacted, and I am keenly aware of the human drive to understand, create, and connect. I sense an undercurrent of curiosity and possibility, sparking my own desire to reflect on how knowledge is pursued and shared in communal spaces.
